additions.site_name: Equinix Great Oaks South Data Center Campus (SV12, SV18 and SV19), 123-131 Great Oaks Blvd, San Jose
additions.name: Equinix SV12x — data-hall fit-outs (San Jose building permits 2024-108710-CI, 2026-141003-CI and 2026-140996-CI)

status.summary: The City of San Jose issued three building permits of subtype 'Data Center' for tenant-improvement work at 123 Great Oaks Blvd (APN 706-02-054 in the permit records; owner of record Equinix Hyperscale (2SV12) LLC): 2024-108710-CI 'EQUINIX TI (BEPM 100%) DATA CENTER' (43,317 sq ft, valuation USD 48.4 million) on 8 October 2026, 2026-141003-CI 'SV12x-F2.3 FIT OUT DATA HALL (I & J)' (14,585 sq ft, USD 14.5 million) on 16 October 2026 and 2026-140996-CI 'SV12x-F2.4 FIT OUT (K & L)' (14,585 sq ft, USD 18.0 million) on 19 October 2026. The City's Active Building Permits list (current to 26 October 2026) shows each with building, electrical, plumbing and mechanical plan approvals complete and no final date. The project recorded here is the data-hall fit-out these permits authorise inside the SV12 building of Equinix's Great Oaks South Data Center; it is permitted as of 19 October 2026, when the last of the three was issued. No start or completion of the works, added data-hall capacity or IT load is established, and nothing is asserted about the operating state of SV12, SV18 or SV19.
status.permit_reference: City of San Jose building permits 2024-108710-CI (issued 2026-10-08), 2026-141003-CI (issued 2026-10-16) and 2026-140996-CI (issued 2026-10-19), 123 Great Oaks Blvd, San Jose (APN 706-02-054 as carried in the permit records)
status.permit_identity_review: The three permits appear in the City's Active, Under Inspection and Last 30 Days Building Permits lists of 26 October 2026 with the same issue dates, completed plan approvals and no final date, so they are issued permits, not applications; 2024-108710-CI was filed in 2024 and issued on 8 October 2026. Each is a commercial building permit of subtype 'Data Center' whose folder name describes data-centre tenant improvement or the fit-out of data halls I & J and K & L of 'SV12x' (the SV12 building), so the consent covers data-centre works themselves, not a utility, air or trade-only permit. The Energy Commission's notice received 7 May 2026 identifies 123 Great Oaks Boulevard as SV12 of the Great Oaks South Data Center (applicant Equinix LLC), and the owner of record is Equinix Hyperscale (2SV12) LLC. No expiry, revocation or superseding permit appears in the 26 October lists.

locator.precision: Centroid of the union of Santa Clara County FY2026 parcels 706-02-057 (situs 123 Great Oaks Bl, the SV12 building) and 706-02-060 (situs 127 Great Oaks Bl; SV18 at 127 and SV19 at 131), one contiguous polygon of 18.00 geodesic acres, about 481 by 345 m. The centroid lies inside parcel 706-02-060, about 20 m from the SV12 parcel. It locates the three-building Great Oaks South campus, not the SV12 building or its data halls.
locator.identity_review: The Energy Commission notice of determination received 7 May 2026 (SCH 2020100431) says the Great Oaks South Data Center consists of three two-story data-center buildings, SV12, SV18 and SV19, at 123, 127 and 131 Great Oaks Boulevard in San Jose, with Equinix LLC as project applicant. The San Jose permits place the SV12x fit-out at 123 Great Oaks Bl and the 'EQUINIX SV19 DATA CENTER BLDG' permit (2026-118560-CI) at 131 Great Oaks Bl on APN 706-02-060. In the county FY2026 parcel layer situs 123 Great Oaks Bl is parcel 706-02-057 and situs 127 Great Oaks Bl is parcel 706-02-060; they adjoin. The layer has no parcel 706-02-054, the number the permit records still carry for 123 Great Oaks Bl; the link rests on the identical situs address. No geocoder, company map point or city centre is used.
locator.uncertainty_reason: The county publishes its parcel polygons 'as is' with no positional accuracy; the point represents an 18-acre, three-building campus, and the positions of the SV12 building and its data halls within it are not published.

status.summary: DataBank's SFO1 page, in its version modified on 29 September 2026, gives '(SFO1) 5101 Lafayette Street - Santa Clara, CA 95054' and says 'DataBank's SFO1 Silicon Valley data center features a N+1 power design and N+1 cooling and is a carrier-neutral interconnection hub with access to on-site carriers and Internet, fiber, and cross-connect options', with 16,680 IT square feet, 3MW critical IT load, 4 onsite carriers, cabinet colocation, a 100% uptime SLA and 7x24x365 hours of operation and remote hands. This records the facility as operating on 29 September 2026, the modification day of the captured version (bounded below by the Internet Archive copy of 16 May 2026, modified 14 May 2026, with the same facility text, and above by the live capture of 26 October 2026); it is not an opening date, and 3 MW is a design rating, not observed load.

locator.precision: Centroid of Santa Clara County FY2026 parcel 097-46-015 (situs 5101 Lafayette St, Santa Clara 95054; 1.39 geodesic acres, about 132 by 85 m). It locates the parcel at the operator's address, not a building footprint or DataBank's data halls.
locator.identity_review: DataBank gives '(SFO1) 5101 Lafayette Street - Santa Clara, CA 95054' on the SFO1 page (also in the Internet Archive copy of 16 May 2026) and on its Silicon Valley market page. A county parcel query for situs house number 5101 on LAFAYETTE returns exactly one parcel, 097-46-015, in the City of Santa Clara. No geocoder, company map point or city centre is used.
locator.uncertainty_reason: The county publishes its parcel polygons 'as is' with no positional accuracy; the centroid represents a 1.4-acre parcel, and the building and DataBank's space within it are not located.

status.summary: Colovore's Silicon Valley market page, in the version published on 14 September 2026, describes its 'flagship locations where Fortune 500 companies, web giants and fast-growing startups have taken applications from lab to production' with smart-hands services and a customer portal, and says 'Two active sites in the heart of Silicon Valley—both currently sold out', listing SJC01 (Santa Clara, CA; 6 MW, Hall 1 sold out) and SJC02 (Santa Clara; 6 MW, Hall 1 sold out). This records both Santa Clara data centers as operating on 14 September 2026, the publication of the captured version (Webflow stamp in the page; bounded below by the Internet Archive copy of 10 July 2026, published 9 July, and above by the Internet Archive copy of 23 September 2026 carrying the same 14 September stamp, all with identical text). It is not an opening date, and the MW figures are operator ratings, not observed load.

locator.precision: Centroid of the union of Santa Clara County FY2026 parcels 224-08-139 (situs 1101 Space Park Dr, SJC01) and 224-08-154 (situs 3060 Raymond St, SJC02), one contiguous polygon of 3.44 geodesic acres, about 98 by 155 m. The centroid lies inside parcel 224-08-139, about 1 m from the SJC02 parcel. It locates the two-building campus, not either building.
locator.identity_review: Colovore's release of 19 November 2024 places SJC02 at 3060 Raymond Street, 'Immediately adjacent to its first data center at 1101 Space Park Drive', and its market page lists SJC01 and SJC02, both in Santa Clara, as its two active Silicon Valley sites. A county parcel query by situs returns 224-08-139 at 1101 SPACE PARK DR and 224-08-154 at 3060 RAYMOND ST, both in the City of Santa Clara; the two adjoin. No geocoder, company map point or city centre is used.
locator.uncertainty_reason: The county publishes its parcel polygons 'as is' with no positional accuracy; the point represents a 3.4-acre two-parcel campus, and the two buildings are not located individually (parcel 224-08-139 has eight situs addresses).

additions.site_name: STACK POR03 Hillsboro Campus (4735 NE Starr Blvd)
additions.name: STACK POR03 — existing data-centre operations (72 MW operational critical capacity)

status.summary: STACK's POR03 - Hillsboro page, in the version modified on 27 August 2026 (bounded below by an Internet Archive copy of 13 May 2026 with an earlier modification time and a different POR03D floor area, and no archived copy in between), states that the 55-acre Hillsboro campus 'provides approximately 200MW of total critical capacity, including 25MW with near term availability, 96MW of expansion capacity, and 72MW of operational critical capacity'. This records existing data-centre operations on the POR03 campus on 27 August 2026 (UTC modification day); it is not an opening date. The 72 MW equals the stated ratings of POR03A, POR03B and POR03C (24 MW each); POR03D (25 MW, 'near term availability') and POR03E/F (96 MW expansion) are not covered by this status. Capacities are operator ratings, not observed load.

locator.precision: Centroid of Washington County taxlot 1N2210001900 (situs 4735 NE Starr Blvd, Hillsboro; 17.53 acres, about 407 by 207 m) from Metro RLIS Taxlots (Public), returned in WGS84 by the service. 4735 NE Starr Blvd is the address STACK published for its POR03 campus. The point locates that published-address taxlot within the 55-acre campus; it is not a building, the whole campus extent or a surveyed boundary.
locator.identity_review: STACK's October 2020 release says it 'broke ground on the construction of its new POR03 campus in Hillsboro' and that the campus is 'located at 4735 NE Starr Blvd'; its February 2022 release names POR03A as the first building of the same 84 MW flagship campus, and its July 2022 release enlarges that flagship campus to 200 MW and about 50 acres, matching the 200 MW and 55 acres on the current POR03 page and the POR03D brochure. Metro's Master Address File point for 4735 NE STARR BLVD (source City of Hillsboro) carries taxlot number 1N2210001900 and lies inside it, 66.5 m from the centroid. The public taxlot layer omits ownership, so STACK's ownership of this or the other campus taxlots is not asserted; the identity rests on the published address. No geocoder, map viewport or OpenStreetMap data is used.
locator.uncertainty_reason: Metro publishes no positional accuracy for the compiled taxlot polygons; the centroid represents a 17.5-acre taxlot of about 407 by 207 m that is only part of the 55-acre campus, and the operating buildings are not separately located.
